notes:
Passed on the fake backend with python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/farama-foundation__vizdoom --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). No hardware was attached and neither the hardware nor the sim backend was run. Model-authored and unreviewed. The fake is the package's own analytic F0 stand-in (fake.py) for the registered VizdoomBasic-v1. ViZDoom needs its compiled engine extension and gymnasium, neither importable where the gate ran, so the fake was never compared with upstream and the sim path (gymnasium.make) was not run. native is the card's second confirmed entry symbol, VizdoomEnv, because it defines reset/step/close and the spaces; the registered entry point VizdoomScenarioEnv only resolves the scenario config path and inherits that class. The derived action space is the real one: three binary buttons (scenarios/basic.cfg:30-35) with max_buttons_pressed=1 (gymnasium_wrapper/__init__.py:30-33) give Discrete(4), and the fake uses the same button-map order (gymnasium_wrapper/base_gymnasium_env.py:448-454). NOT COVERED: Doom dynamics (map, monster, hit detection, damage, death), rendering and snapshot/restore; the fake never terminates and only truncates at the scenario's 300-tic episode timeout (scenarios/basic.cfg:26-27). The fake observation is an 8 x 8 x 3 screen plus one gamevariable, where the real observation is a 240 x 320 x 3 screen (scenarios/basic.cfg:14) plus the AMMO2 game variable (scenarios/basic.cfg:38); the smaller screen is a stand-in that keeps receipts small, and both real sizes are also in fidelity.gaps. The 14-tic episode_start_time (scenarios/basic.cfg:23-24) and the per-tic living-reward accounting are simplified. Two warning codes are expected of the Gymnasium family and were not suppressed: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.index, and seed twice). There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue_requests. driver.lock.json records authored_by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 run wC-014 and reviewed_by null. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
